svg.text: Footing depth your state's building code requires, in inches below grade
A Florida footing starts 12 inches down. A Maine one starts 6 feet down.
22 states publish two code depths. The map shows the deeper zone, because under-digging is the costly mistake.
Depths are code minimums, not last winter's measured frost.
All 73 code zones, each with the state code section that sets the number
